findings.title: Apply the declared strict JSON and byte bound to retained release bytes
findings.body: runtime_release is read and hash-matched but never passed through _bounded or the strict JSON scanner. With exact packaged assets, the actual unchanged _release verifier and observer return both a matching-hash duplicate-key manifest and a4,008,655-byte manifest. The declared scanner rejects both. The source-bound native fixture manifest is valid and only8,636bytes; this is a demonstrated broader contract/bounds hole, not a claim that the supplied native run used malformed data.
findings.requestedChange: Strict-scan and bound exact release bytes before treating them as a retained original/output; retain positive and matching-hash duplicate/oversize refusal controls.

findings.title: Distinguish generated expressions from ordinary defaults
findings.body: Every pg_attrdef expression is labeled defaultExpression, including the retained key-bucket generated column with generated=s. The flag and raw text preserve information, but the field name incorrectly describes a generated expression as an ordinary default. Root independently identified this same issue before integration.
findings.requestedChange: Use an explicit none/default/generated expression discriminator and consistency checks without parsing or executing SQL; independently compare actual expressions and flags in the next native test cohort.

findings.title: Include the imported test/configuration fixture in the source snapshot
findings.body: The runner pins only three base test modules, but captured test_catalog_relational_support.py:12 imports test_preparation; baseline test_preparation.py:13-14 reads acceptance-input-capacity-v0.1.fixture.json at import time. Both dependencies are absent from source-before.json and source-inputs.zip, so their loaded bytes receive neither capture nor endpoint drift checking. The505selected entries and their archive do match exactly; the gap is incomplete loaded test/fixture closure, not evidence that those505endpoint claims are false.
findings.requestedChange: Add the imported test module and import-time fixture to the native source input inventory, retain their original bytes and before/after pins in a fresh source-bound campaign. Preserve the current R3 observations as selected-endpoint evidence.

findings.title: Independently compare the captured native default expressions
findings.body: The design requires independent default correspondence (native-source-observation.md:92-93), but the native test column query/assertion compares only attnum, name, typeOid, typmod and collationOid. None of the13non-null captured defaultExpression values is independently checked. Replacing all13withnull leaves every compared relation/column/constraint tuple unchanged. Thus the four-test receipt does not establish the stated default observation obligation, although its selected comparisons may all be valid.
findings.requestedChange: Extend the independent native column census to compare default presence and deparsed expression text, with a mutant/wrong-default control; retain actual native evidence separately from the supplied-row tests.
